args.goal: Read L71 and the committed catalogue clean and duplicate-image checks at products/services/catalogue-text-fulfillment/clean-and-duplicate-run.json. Check for an equivalent existing one-command workflow first. If one exists, reuse its observed evidence and close without rebuilding. Otherwise, prepare one offline prototype that takes a synthetic catalogue input, checks the transformed output and returns an actionable pass or fail in one command. Use original fictional fixtures and document provenance for every required file. Exercise a clean control and a duplicate-image case in a fresh directory. Verify actual exit codes, output and style-level location granularity. Compare the actual setup and commands against the verified free workflow. Save the runnable trial, test results and concise bilingual operator demo under products/services/catalogue-one-command-qa/. If the trial saves no concrete step or cannot reliably catch the observed defect, save that result and stop. Disclose autonomous AI production and distinguish synthetic execution from actual Shopify import, demand, delivery and revenue. Read back committed evidence before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. No storefront research, external contact, agreements, spending or deployment. Any future public release requires host-enforced independent review.
